title: Create conformance matrix and verification harness for streaming + function/tool-call behavior on newly onboarded models
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: For every newly onboarded model we publish a concise conformance matrix and run an automated verification harness that certifies streaming semantics and function/tool-call behavior across pinned model versions and performance profiles. This ticket scopes the matrix shape, the harness tests, integration with the model catalog publishing flow, and a set of runtime smoke tests to catch regressions in streaming chunking, early-close semantics, KV cache interplay, and tool-call event ordering. The work is required so that Dedicated/Private customers who pin model versions and enable streaming or tool-calls get predictable behavior matching the published performance profile.
acceptance_criteria: A conformance matrix template exists and is attached to the model catalog entry for every newly onboarded model version

An automated test harness runs as part of model onboarding that exercises streaming chunks, partial outputs, function/tool-call initiation and termination, and asserts event ordering and finalization semantics
Pinning behavior verification: tests confirm model@<version> returns identical streaming/tool-call traces across hosted and dedicated runtimes within tolerance thresholds
Performance-profile publishing must include a streaming-capable flag and documented limits (max chunk size, max prefetch latency)
Failures are surfaced as blocking warnings in the onboarding pipeline and generate a reproducible artifact (log + recorded trace) linked from the model catalog entry
test_plan: Build unit tests that synthesize typical tool-call sequences including: immediate tool call on first token, tool call after multi-chunk prefix, nested tool call sequencing
Integration test that spawns a streaming client and asserts on chunk boundaries, final EOF, and KV cache rehydration across resumed sessions
Cross-runtime consistency test that compares traces from hosted API and a Dedicated test pool using the same pinned model version
Stress test to validate behavior under batching: concurrent streams, mixed short/long sequences, and ensured ordering under backpressure
Regression suite to run on performance-profile updates to detect semantic changes introduced by quantization or kernel selection
comments: 2026-03-08 - Ava Patel: Created ticket after postmortem with model-onboarding team. Observed two incidents where function-call events arrived out of order when KV cache rehydration occurred mid-stream.

2026-03-09 - Marcus Nguyen: Spike results: LlamaClone-v2@2026-02-25 and RedwoodOpen-3B@2026-03-01 show different chunk-delimiting behavior under the same runtime config. Need to normalize expectations in matrix.
2026-03-10 - Design review (Emily Zhao): Recommended matrix fields: stream_supported, max_chunk_bytes, min_emit_latency_ms, tool_call_sync, tool_call_async, kv_rehydrate_safe
2026-03-11 - QA (Samuel Ortiz): Added stress test plan and reported initial flakiness for nested tool-call sequences when batch size > 8. Filed ENG-30212 as a blocker for harness stabilization.

2026-03-12 - Marcus Nguyen: Implemented baseline harness and integrated onboarding job. Current false positive rate ~4% on hosted canary; investigating differences in kernel selection when quantized model variants are auto-selected.

2026-03-12 - Product (Rina Das): Please ensure matrix is surfaced in the console model page and the onboarding checklist. We must publish 'streaming-capable' badge only after harness passes in both hosted and dedicated environments.
notes: Implementation must avoid adding per-model heavy instrumentation in production paths. Prefer lightweight recorded traces written to artifact storage and sampled on onboarding runs. Coordinate with runtime team for a test-only flag to force deterministic kernel selection during verification. Follow-up tasks: ENG-30212 (harness flakiness), ENG-30344 (console exposure of matrix), ENG-30401 (publish performance-profile streaming limits).
